yugiohLastCard.name: Chaos Phantasm
yugiohLastCard.desc: Target 1 of your banished LIGHT Tuners and 1 of your banished Level 8 or lower DARK non-Tuners; return both to the GY, then Special Summon 1 LIGHT or DARK Synchro Monster from your Extra Deck whose Level equals the total Levels of those returned monsters.

yugiohLastCard.name: Igknight Cavalier
yugiohLastCard.desc:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
If you have an "Igknight" card in your other Pendulum Zone: You can destroy both cards in your Pendulum Zones, and if you do, add 1 FIRE Warrior-Type monster from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.

[ Monster Effect ] 
''The vaunted weapons of this pink Igknight have inflicted as much damage to her enemies as to her own troops, but she gets results so very few complain.''

yugiohLastCard.name: Tentacle Plant
yugiohLastCard.desc: ''A carnivorous plant that has an outgrowth of tentacles. It attacks someone nearby by extending its tentacles.''
